scripts.setup: npm --prefix agent ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix agent run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix agent run check && npm --prefix agent run check:tests && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix agent test && npm --prefix web test -- --maxWorkers=1
scripts.catalogue:import: npm --prefix agent run build && python scripts/catalogue/import-job-catalogue.py
